svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Make two, a mirror pair (the left arm is drawn). 10 mm steel plate:

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: three hole centres in one plane, ends rounded to 18 mm radius,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Pivot hole 20 mm at the back end.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Axle hole 20 mm, 110 mm ahead of the pivot and 45 mm lower.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check it against the hub motor's shaft and flats.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Front end centre 195 mm ahead of the pivot and 95 mm lower.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Spring tab: 10 mm plate 44 x 44, welded square to the arm's outer

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: face at the front end, its top face 90 mm below the pivot centre

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: and centred on the front end. The spring sits on it.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: the pivot pin passes the back hole; the motor shaft passes the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: axle hole with a 5 mm spacer between wheel and arm and a nut outside.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the two arms laid back to back have their holes in line.
